reasons.plausibility: Using larger feedstock particles to increase coating thickness and reduce oxidation is broadly consistent with thermal-spray principles, though potential issues with particle trajectory and splat morphology remain possible.
reasons.testability: The head-to-head comparison under identical conditions using baseline vs. larger-particle feedstock is a clear, feasible approach to prove or disprove the claim.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses the thickness shortfall challenge and proposes a practical, clearly testable solution relevant to bond coat deposition.
